FILING_DESTINATION.detail: participant-instructions.md 'Where you file this': file with the clerk's office of your local Alaska trial court — the court named in the case number at the top of the form — 'The form says so in its own words', and the corpus TF-810 text confirms it ('you may file this request form at your local trial court'). FEE_AND_WAIVER.detail: the fee question is delegated to a named checkable authority in a dedicated line, not a catch-all: 'Any filing fee is not stated here, because it is not established in any source this packet holds and an unsourced figure in a filing instruction is worse than none. Ask the clerk.' — where 'the clerk' is the clerk's office of the local trial court named two sentences above and identifiable from the case number. Under the house standard, delegation to a named checkable authority passes; no figure is invented and the reason is stated.

SERVICE.detail: re-measured against the pinned official form's own face, which the vf01 read did not have the corpus to consult. TF-810 imposes NO service duty on the requester: the full form text (extracted in this lane from the corpus bytes at c5e55ce0…) contains no certificate of service, no 'serve a copy' direction and no opposing party — it is a correction request, not a petition, and the form closes its own loop internally: 'Instructions to Court Clerk: Email this request and final disposition order to the HelpDesk', followed by the court's response block back to the requestor ('Case removed / Case not removed', 'Date sent to requestor'). There is no service step for the packet to describe, and the instructions state the complete filing path the form prescribes — file at the clerk's office, the clerk's block at the foot is the court's. vf01's FAIL ('the packet never mentions who must be served or how at all') measured the instructions' silence without measuring whether service is owed; the form's face answers that it is not. The route's census lines 'Record serviceRecipients/serviceMethod/serviceTiming; current evidence is not recorded' are census bookkeeping present on every route in the worklist, not proof of a service duty. IMPROVEMENT, not an omission: a one-line 'you do not need to serve anyone; the clerk routes this request' would make the absence explicit for the participant.

SELF_HELP_STOP.detail: stated in 'What this packet is not': not legal advice, not filed for you, and it does not decide whether the case comes off the index. The stop is drawn item by item: every ground is left to the participant ('only you know which is true'), the attachments for grounds 4 and 9 are named and not supplied ('The platform holds neither attachment and does not attach them for you'), the signature and date are the participant's, and the clerk's block is the court's.
